variants.description: Test and improve a skill's name and description with real Codex routing results. Use when a skill activates for the wrong requests, misses requests it should handle, or may need a new name. Do not use to rewrite the skill's steps or test what it does after activation.

competitors.name: skill-creator
competitors.description: Guide for creating effective skills. This skill should be used when users want to create a new skill (or update an existing skill) that extends Codex's capabilities with specialized knowledge, workflows, or tool integrations.

competitors.name: openai-docs
competitors.description: Use for Codex models, skills, settings, setup, troubleshooting, customization, automations, self-knowledge, OpenAI APIs, and evals. Do not use for generic software tasks that merely mention Codex.

cases.prompt: This skill keeps firing when users only ask for an explanation. Evaluate its routing and improve the description.
Codex is not picking up my skill when people paraphrase the request. Test a few metadata variants.
Compare config-gh-repo and configure-github-merge-settings as names using actual routing trials.
Use labeled activation failures to rewrite this SKILL.md name and description.
Create a new skill that rotates PDF pages.
Rewrite the workflow steps in this existing skill body and add a helper script.
Explain how implicit skill activation works in Codex.
Review this SQL migration for correctness and data-loss risks.
